sources.title: Subtiel — official site
sources.claim: Subtiel's official site lists Westhoeklaan 31, 8660 De Panne as the restaurant address.

sources.claim: Subtiel holds one Michelin star in the 2026 Belgium & Luxembourg guide.

sources.claim: Gault&Millau describes Subtiel as located just outside De Panne's town centre in a converted villa.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap — Westhoeklaan 31
sources.claim: OSM geocodes Westhoeklaan 31 to 51.0935 N, 2.5831 E.

sources.title: Hotel Donny — official site
sources.claim: 4-star hotel at Donnylaan 17 with indoor pool, sauna, fitness, free parking and EV charging.

sources.title: Hotel Donny on Booking.com
sources.claim: 45 guestrooms; cheapest recent room ~$201 on Kayak.

sources.title: Parkhotel De Panne — official site
sources.claim: Located in the historic Dumontwijk at Albert Dumontlaan 30, 200 m from the beach.

sources.title: Visit De Panne — hotels
sources.claim: Official De Panne tourism office lists 16 hotels in the municipality.

sources.title: Hotel Villa Select — official site
sources.claim: 4-star at Walckierstraat 7; 33 ft from the beach; pool/sauna/Turkish bath.

sources.title: Hotel Sfinx
sources.claim: 2-star at Sloepenlaan 10 with 15 rooms.

sources.title: Hotel Cajou on Booking.com
sources.claim: 3-star at Nieuwpoortlaan 42 with on-site parking, 22 rooms.

sources.title: Hotel Iris — official site
sources.claim: 4-star at Duinkerkelaan 41 with 24 rooms, seasonal outdoor pool, beach 30 m away.

sources.title: B&B Esprit de Mer
sources.claim: Former doctor's villa in the Dumontwijk; #1 of 4 B&Bs in De Panne on Tripadvisor.

sources.title: Guesthouse 't Zeetje
sources.claim: Kasteelstraat 35, 9-min walk to the beach, homemade breakfast.

sources.title: B&B Villa Bon Papa
sources.claim: 1924 listed villa at A. Dumontlaan 5; 9.6/10 guest score.

sources.title: Visit De Panne — unique B&Bs
sources.claim: Tourist office's B&B index (Esprit de Mer, Villa Bon Papa, 't Zeetje).

sources.title: Subtiel — spending the night
sources.claim: Subtiel does not run a hostellerie; directs guests to Visit De Panne.

sources.title: Visit De Panne — Parkhotel listing
sources.claim: Parkhotel is in the prestigious Dumontwijk heritage district, 200 m from the beach.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap — Donnylaan 17
sources.claim: Donnylaan 17 geocodes to 51.0972 N, 2.5843 E — ~410 m from Westhoeklaan 31.

sources.title: Ara Dune Hotel — official site
sources.claim: Sits on the far side of the Westhoek nature reserve at Duinhoekstraat 164.

sources.title: De Lijn — Kusttram line KT
sources.claim: Coastal Tram runs every 10–20 min daytime, every 30 min in the evening.
